name: robot_host_down
regression: Whole-host loss with the publishers gone from the graph: the counterpart of transport_loss__robot_host, where the graph still advertises them (the wrong-interface signature). The finding's graph evidence must differ between the two.
initial_conditions: No fault. Baseline for false positives.
injected_fault: Both robot-host publisher nodes leave the graph at t=3.0 s and every robot-host topic stops for the rest of the run.
